settings.label: System code
settings.help: Your BBSLink system code, from your account at bbslink.net.

settings.label: Auth code
settings.help: Hashed with the session token; never sent in the clear.

settings.label: Scheme code
settings.help: The second BBSLink secret. Hashed the same way as the auth code.

settings.label: Server host
settings.help: Where the games live. Only change this if BBSLink moves.

settings.label: HTTP port
settings.help: Used for the token and auth requests.

settings.label: Telnet port
settings.help: Used for the game session itself.

settings.label: Request timeout (seconds)
settings.help: How long to wait for BBSLink before giving up.

settings.label: Default game
settings.help: What the door opens with when the user names no game. MENU is BBSLink's own menu. Per-game codes stay in bbslink.cfg.
